finding: A user who follows the two query how-tos in a fresh install gets `usage-query: usage package not found (no .agent-factory/usage/analysis/ or packages/usage/)`. Reproduction: `init-factory --target /tmp/qa1/proj2 --source <worktree> --project-name qaproj`, then `.agent-factory/factory/scripts/usage-query session_usage --persist usage.duckdb`. The pages `query-usage-views.md` and `explore-usage-in-the-browser.md` open with the task and say the wrapper scripts find the installed add-on. Neither says that the add-on is optional and absent by default, and neither links to `install-usage-add-on.md`. After `init-factory --add usage` the same command works. Fix: add one sentence with a link to `install-usage-add-on.md` at the top of both pages, so the reader learns the prerequisite before the first command.
why_this_severity: The chapter index says the add-on is optional and the install page works (no to fails_purpose). A reader who lands on a query page from a search gets an error that names the missing folder, and must find the install page without a link.
